description: Test script for Employee Tax Exemption Declaration in ERPNext, including test cases for duplicate categories, payroll periods, and exemption amounts, as well as helper functions to create payroll periods and exemption categories.

classes.name: TestEmployeeTaxExemptionDeclaration
classes.description: Unit test class for Employee Tax Exemption Declaration functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by creating employees, payroll period, exemption categories, and clearing existing declarations.

methods.name: test_duplicate_category_in_declaration
methods.description: Tests that duplicate exemption categories within a declaration raise a validation error.

methods.name: test_duplicate_entry_for_payroll_period
methods.description: Tests that duplicate declarations for the same payroll period and employee raise a custom error, but allow different employees.

methods.name: test_exemption_amount
methods.description: Verifies total exemption amount calculation across multiple declaration entries.
